notes.title: Reporting Live: The Arcade Christmas Update is here!
notes.content:
What's up!

Our super secret Arcade Christmas update is OUT NOW! The low-down - so many of our rooms are now so much more fun as we've packed them out with ARCADE GAMES! There's a tonne of different games and machines all across the entire game - so jump in and check them out for yourself.

Arcade Machines:
Air Hockey
Arkanoid
Skee-Ball
2D Outta Hand
Claw Machine
Hands-Dance Revolution
Piano
Drums
Whack-A-Mole - Upgraded with hammers
Basketball - Now with a court and a mini-game!

You'll find the machines scaretted throughout the game, but level 406 will have all the machines making it the ultimate gameplay room!

There's a festive new main menu, music and decorations, a new Christmas skin as well as a tutorial hat.
Also, I'm a tree now. 
Top points to whoever makes the best track on the fart keyboard, and we wanna see who's the best at Ball Throw.

Get in there and have fun!

notes.title: The Spooky Update arrives!
notes.content:
The Update Lurks....

[i]In the dark of night, when things begin to creak,
A spooky new update arrives this week!
The dark of night has come alive,
If you log in, will you survive?
Beware the patch notes, they're cursed, they say,
Arriving on time to haunt, today![/i]

This spooky update is fully of tricks and toil, featuring:

- 3D capture camera - allowing trhe player to stream and record *Steam exclusive*
- Spooky Skeleton skin
- New Halloween themes tutorial hat
- New Main Menu visuals
- Music Updates

Stay spooky, everyone.
